description: The candidate will be able to manufacture and assemble various Electrical and Electronic connectors and harness, circuits and components, Industrial electrical- electronic and High-power conditioning, and Aerospace industry. The Candidate will have exposure on Electrical and Electronic, Power circuits, PCB Technology, Microcontrollers, PLC, Pneumatics, Robotics and IOT and Industry 4.0.The subjects covered in this programme are - Mechanical and Electrical Drives, Safety Health and Environment, Introduction to Robotics, Connector Manufacturing, PCB Technology, Starter Motor Technology, Testing of wire harness, UPS Technology, Assembly Techniques, Advanced Wire Harness Manufacturing, Introduction to IoT and Industry 4.0, Production Management, Industrial Management, Electrical Equipment Maintenance, Professional Ethics, Connector Assembly, Automation in Manufacturing, Employability Skills, Robotics Lab, Wire harness testing lab, IoT Lab, Project/Case Study, OJT

horizontalPathName: After completing the 3-year full-time programme and gaining 3 years of industry experience, the job holder can work as a Line Supervisor, Maintenance Engineer, Quality Inspector, Team Leader, Maintenance Manager, or related Electrical Equipment Manufacturing professional.
